messages.text: I'm allergic to eggs, please factor that in.
How do I make a proper Caesar dressing? The kind you'd get at a steakhouse.

Whisk together 2 egg yolks, juice of 1 lemon, 4 minced anchovies, 2 cloves grated garlic, a teaspoon of Dijon, and a tablespoon of Worcestershire. Slowly drizzle in ½ cup olive oil while whisking. Finish with a generous handful of grated parmesan and cracked pepper. That's the steakhouse version.
